answer_units: strip only recognized explicit presentation units from the candidate and gold before equivalence checking; preserve the original boxed candidate and categorical text answers in the trace
cap_hits: officially incorrect; strict-box result retained as a counterfactual diagnostic
generated_text: score the complete saved generation verbatim without inference, continuation, truncation, or retokenization
gold_answer: reuse the correct_answer stored with the immutable source prediction after verifying it against the canonical benchmark
source_join: join merged prediction and raw-generation records by problem_id in canonical MATH-500 order
stop_token_id: null when the source Axolotl artifact did not retain the exact stopping token; diagnostic only and not used in the V4 correctness decision
